scientific_integrity: Exact spectral decomposition, rational-relation classification, and continuous Kronecker criterion; all unbounded conclusions rely on written proof, not finite tests.
scientific_limitations: Two-fold independent-fibre blowups of unweighted triangle-leaf cones only; no time bounds or classification of arbitrary nonregular cones. Independent audit is not performed.
title: Proper pretty good state transfer in blow-ups of nonregular triangle-leaf cones
